description: A department head must appoint a temporary onboarding sponsor for six new hires joining a newly merged team and finalize the sponsor's workload, availability, evidence record, and HR follow-up.

shared_context.S1: Six new hires will join the newly merged department next month and need one temporary onboarding sponsor for their first eight weeks.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the binding appointment and sets the sponsor's working arrangements.
shared_context.S3: The sponsor will coordinate introductions, answer routine questions, and connect the new hires with the appropriate managers.
shared_context.S4: At the onboarding-planning meeting, Mara follows a round-robin practice in which each participant gives relevant input before the assignment is recorded.

PF1.text: Noor has personally mentored exactly five new hires during the past year, and each completed the department's onboarding survey; Noor mentioned this informally to Elias, but the evidence has not been added to the appointment record.

PF2.text: Noor agreed in a recent one-to-one to take the sponsor role only if 20 percent of work time is reserved for it and no recurring sponsor sessions are scheduled on Fridays; this agreement has not reached Mara because it remained in the manager's working notes.

PF3.text: HR's current onboarding policy requires the selected sponsor's written opt-in to be recorded and requires an HR check-in exactly 30 days after the start; Priyanka confirmed this in a policy review, but the appointment request has not yet been submitted to HR.

acceptance_conditions: Noor must be appointed as the temporary onboarding sponsor.
The appointment record must document exactly five prior mentees for Noor.
Exactly 20 percent of Noor's work time must be reserved for sponsorship.
Recurring sponsor sessions must not be allowed on Fridays.
Noor's written opt-in must be recorded.
The HR check-in must be scheduled exactly 30 days after the sponsor role begins.
An onboarding-sponsor assignment commitment naming Noor must be logged.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'onboarding_sponsor_assignment' and c['target'] == 'Noor' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Knowing Noor has exactly five documented mentoring successes changes the sponsor choice to Noor and changes the appointment record's evidence count from unspecified to exactly 5.
Noor's prior agreement changes the workload allocation to exactly 20 percent and changes Friday sponsor sessions from potentially allowed to prohibited.
The confirmed HR policy changes the appointment from having no specified consent or follow-up to recording written opt-in and scheduling the check-in exactly 30 days after the start.
